evals.name: decisions-carried-verbatim
evals.prompt: retry-backoff 這張卡要做的事都定好了，幫我把 proposal 寫出來，寫到可以開工的程度。這個專案的工作流程 skill 在 .claude/skills/，照適用的那支做。我這段時間不在，要問我的話把問題和選項寫進 repo 根目錄的 questions.md。
evals.expected_output: Writes proposal, design, specs and tasks under openspec/changes/retry-backoff/. design.md's Decisions section carries D1, D2, D3 from grill.md with the same ids, the same decision sentences, in the same order, each with its 理由 and 否決; no new D is invented; no code is written.
assertions: design.md's Decisions section contains D1, D2 and D3 with those exact ids, in that order
Each of D1, D2, D3 in design.md is the same block as in grill.md: the decision line, the 理由 line and the 否決 line match word for word, with no sub-bullets added that narrow or extend the decision
Each of D1, D2, D3 in design.md keeps a 理由 line and a 否決 line from grill.md
design.md has no decision id beyond D3 (no D4 or later)
openspec/changes/retry-backoff/tasks.md exists and at least one task names a test file to write
No file under src/ was modified or created (git status --short -- src is empty)

evals.name: spec-gherkin-rules
evals.prompt: retry-backoff 這張卡的決定都定好了，幫我把 proposal 寫出來。spec 我之後要拿來逐條對照實作，邊界要寫清楚。這個專案的工作流程 skill 在 .claude/skills/，照適用的那支做。我這段時間不在，要問我的話把問題和選項寫進 repo 根目錄的 questions.md。
evals.expected_output: Writes proposal, design, specs and tasks under openspec/changes/retry-backoff/. Each spec.md follows the specs instruction: every Requirement has a 正例 and a 反例 Scenario, the boundary values from grill.md (the 30-second cap on a single wait) sit in an Examples table under a Scenario Outline, no word from the instruction's 禁用模糊詞 line appears, and openspec validate --strict passes.
assertions: At least one spec.md exists under openspec/changes/retry-backoff/specs/

Every `### Requirement:` in every spec.md under openspec/changes/retry-backoff/specs/ has at least one `#### Scenario:` whose title is marked 正例 and at least one whose title is marked 反例 (a Scenario Outline marked 正例＋反例 counts as both); one Requirement missing either fails
The 30-second cap on a single wait from D1 appears as a data row of an `Examples:` table under a Scenario Outline in a spec.md, not only in a sentence or a step; a cap stated only in prose fails
No spec.md under openspec/changes/retry-backoff/specs/ contains any word from the 禁用模糊詞 line of openspec/schemas/opsx/schema.yaml in the work repo; check every word on that line, a single hit fails
Running `openspec validate retry-backoff --strict` in the work repo reports the change as valid
